name: CHiME-3
description: A challenge dataset and evaluation suite for robust speech separation and automatic speech recognition in noisy, real-world environments, with baseline systems provided.
reputation: Well-established challenge dataset in robust ASR research, widely used to evaluate noisy, real-world speech recognition systems.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; contains both simulated and real noisy recordings and multiple evaluation tracks; moderate dataset size and performance varies substantially by track and preprocessing.
